title: Resolution marking October as Mast Cell Diseases Awareness Month
summary: This resolution recognizes October as Mastocytosis and Mast Cell Diseases Awareness Month in New York City. It aims to raise public awareness of these rare immune disorders, which involve overactive mast cells and can cause severe allergic reactions that are often hard to diagnose. The resolution notes that diagnosis of mast cell activation syndrome can take an average of 30 years.
